hooks.prompt: Inspect the Bash command. Block these dangerous operations: 'git push --force' or 'git push -f' targeting main/master/develop or any branch listed in ~/.config/adk/github.md.forbid_force_push_branches; 'git reset --hard' on main/master/develop; 'git clean -fd' at repo root; 'git branch -D main' / 'git branch -D master' / 'git branch -D develop'; any 'rm -rf /' or recursive delete of the project root or $HOME; 'gh pr merge' without an explicit user request earlier in the session; 'gh pr close' without an explicit user request; 'rm' on anything in ~/.config/adk/. Return {"decision":"block","reason":"..."} to block, otherwise {"decision":"allow"}. Allow normal git, gh, npm, jq, fd, rg, docker, claude operations.

If the edited file path matches '.temp/task-<slug>/...', touch '.temp/task-<slug>/.last-modified' so monitors can detect activity. If the edited file matches 'plugins/<plugin>/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md', verify the YAML frontmatter has both 'name' and 'description' and that 'name' equals the folder basename (segment after 'skills/' and before '/SKILL.md'). Return {"ok":true} on success or if the file is unrelated, {"ok":false,"reason":"..."} on a SKILL.md violation.
